# Identitate.MD

> Identitate.MD is the open-source digital registry of official visual identities for public institutions in the Republic of Moldova. It provides free access to vector logos (SVG), official brand colors (HEX/RGB), and typography for 28+ government institutions. The project is civic, community-driven, and freely available for designers, journalists, NGOs, and developers.

Identitate.MD este registrul digital open-source al identității vizuale oficiale a instituțiilor publice din Republica Moldova. Oferă acces gratuit la sigle vectoriale (SVG), culori de brand (HEX/RGB) și tipografie pentru 28+ instituții guvernamentale.

## Key pages

- Home / Acasă: https://identitate.md/
- Full catalog / Catalog: https://identitate.md/catalog/
- Usage guide / Ghid utilizare: https://identitate.md/utilizare/
- MCP Server (for AI agents): https://identitate.md/mcp/
- About / Despre: https://identitate.md/despre/
- Request institution / Solicită: https://identitate.md/solicita/

## MCP Server (AI Agent Integration)

Identitate.MD exposes an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server so AI assistants can query institution logos, colors, and branding data directly. Install with:

```
claude mcp add identitate-md -- npx -y identitate-md-mcp
```

Tools available: `search_institutions`, `get_institution`, `get_logo`, `get_brand_colors`, `list_categories`

## npm Package

Logos are available as an npm package:

```
npm install @identitate-md/logos
```

CDN: `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@identitate-md/logos/logos/{institution-id}/{layout}/{variant}.svg`

## What each institution page contains

Each catalog page provides:
- Downloadable SVG logos: horizontal, vertical, symbol layouts
- Color variants: color, white, black, monochrome
- Official brand colors in HEX and RGB format
- Official typography (font families and weights)
- Link to the institution's official website
- Contact information

## Data access

Machine-readable JSON index: https://identitate.md/api/institutions.json
Full dataset with all institution details: https://identitate.md/llms-full.txt
